create_benchmark_cache: create a BenchmarkCache instance with a custom max size in bytes and optional random number generator
add_benchmark_to_cache: add a Benchmark message to the cache by URI with automatic eviction when size exceeds the maximum
get_benchmark_from_cache: get a cached Benchmark message by its URI string, raising KeyError if not found
check_benchmark_in_cache: check whether a given URI exists in the BenchmarkCache using the in operator
evict_benchmarks_to_capacity: evict random benchmarks from the cache to reduce size below a target byte threshold
